question: A car engine generates a force of 10000 N to move the car 1.2 km in 2 minutes. What is the power of the engine?
solution:
The correcf option is 2

__**Concept:**__

**1. Convert units to standard SI units:**

 
• Force (F) = 10000 N (Newtons) - already in SI units
 
• Distance (d) = 1.2 km = 1.2 x 1000 m = 1200 m (meters)
 
• Time (t) = 2 minutes = 2 x 60 seconds = 120 s (seconds)
